mapper.sql: ec.id, ec.item_code AS code, ec.item_label AS name, ec.sort_order AS sortOrder, ec.is_enabled AS enabled, ec.remark, ((select count(*) from kb_logical_models lm where lm.model_family = ec.item_code and lm.is_deleted = 0) + (select count(*) from kb_billing_rules br where br.model_family = ec.item_code and coalesce(br.status, '') <> 'DELETED')) AS usageCount
from ks_enum_configs ec inner join ks_enum_categories c on ec.category_id = c.id where ec.is_deleted = 0 and c.is_deleted = 0 and c.category = 'model_family'
mapper.select:
select
and ( ec.item_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ec.item_label like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ec.remark like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by ec.sort_order, ec.id
